suite: Configurable load pipeline, real browser Worker and shared panel

cases.name: Default explicitly shows disabled automatic fill
Changing plan is not automatic recomputation
Disable merge is a real plan switch
Explicit run executes source-atlas then exactly one fill
UI trace exposes actual completion and durations
Worker receives configured budget and rounds
Turning off fill preserves last output until rerun
Rerun with fill off really skips it
Config editing during running job cannot rewrite active plan
Cancel immediately preserves last complete atlas
Cancelled job cannot overwrite a newer inspection run
Raw inspection keeps original islands rather than reporting a hidden merge
New imported model uses chosen auto plan, not previous manual target
Main policy rejects inspect on missing UV without silent fallback
No browser JS or WebGL errors
